name: Collective Effort
oracle_text:
Escalate—Tap an untapped creature you control. (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls.
blocked_sentences: Escalate—Tap an untapped creature you control. (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)

needs.what: card-level `escalate` accepting a non-mana cost (here a full Cost spec such as {"tap_permanents": {"types": ["Creature"]}} -- tap an untapped creature you control), charged once per mode chosen beyond the first with a distinct creature each time, tied to the mode count the way mana escalate is (casting._additional_ceiling and Game._cast's `exactly`)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader parses `escalate` with ManaCost.parse, desugars it to CostModel(mana=...), and refuses a free (mana value 0) escalate, so "Tap an untapped creature you control" cannot be written there. Hand-desugaring to additional_cost {tap_permanents: ...} + additional_optional + additional_repeatable is multikicker's shape: the loader refuses escalate beside another additional cost, and without the `escalate` flag nothing ties the number of taps to the number of modes, so a plain `or_more` choose_mode would take every mode for zero taps. `spree` prices every mode, the first included.
